meta.description: Harvard University, Cambridge, Massachusetts — oldest institution of higher education in the United States.

description: World's leading Ivy League research university. Comprises Harvard College (undergraduate), 12 graduate/professional schools, and the Harvard Radcliffe Institute. Uses 4.0 GPA scale with letter grades A-F. Follows semester system with fall and spring terms.

academic_calendar.details: Fall semester: Sep-Dec, Spring semester: Jan-May. Reading period before final exams each term.

available.name: Harvard Standard Semester Pattern
available.description: Standard US semester pattern with letter grades A-F on 4.0 GPA scale. Final exams after reading period.
